product_overview: Advus is a web platform for legal practice management that provides a public landing site, full user authentication, and an authenticated dashboard entry point so legal professionals can discover the product, create accounts, and start using the application.
core_goals: Allow prospective users to learn about the product and start a free account from the public landing page.
Enable users to create accounts, sign in, and recover or reset passwords independently.
Provide authenticated users access to the main dashboard to begin using the application.

features.name: Landing Page
features.description: Public marketing page where prospective users learn about Advus and navigate to register.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Scroll through features -> Navigate to /register -> Fill in name -> Fill in email -> Fill in password -> Submit registration -> See account creation confirmation
Navigate to / -> Scroll through features -> Navigate to /register -> Leave required fields blank -> Submit registration -> See validation error indicating missing fields

features.name: User Authentication
features.description: Account lifecycle: register a new account, sign in, request password recovery, and reset a password.
user_flows: Navigate to /register -> Fill in name -> Fill in email -> Fill in password -> Submit registration -> See account creation confirmation -> Navigate to /login -> Fill in email -> Fill in password -> Submit credentials -> See dashboard at /app
Navigate to /login -> Fill in email -> Fill in password -> Submit credentials -> See dashboard at /app
Navigate to /login -> Fill in email -> Fill in wrong password -> Submit credentials -> See authentication error indicating invalid credentials
Navigate to /forgot-password -> Fill in email -> Submit recovery request -> See confirmation instructing to follow reset link

Navigate to /reset-password -> Fill in new password -> Confirm new password -> Submit new password -> See password reset confirmation -> Navigate to /login -> Fill in email -> Fill in new password -> Submit credentials -> See dashboard at /app

features.name: Dashboard Access
features.description: Authenticated entry point where users arrive after sign-in and begin interacting with the application.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Fill in email -> Fill in password -> Submit credentials -> See dashboard at /app and overview of account
Navigate to /app (while authenticated) -> See dashboard overview and core navigation
